data.name: Anvesha
data.gender_notes: Anvesha is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Anvesha is a Sanskrit word derived from the root ‘anu’ (towards) and ‘veshana’ (inquiring, searching). It symbolizes the deep, insatiable desire to explore the unknown and seek answers to life’s mysteries. In Hindu mythology, Anvesha is the name of a goddess who represents knowledge and wisdom. The name Anvesha carries the meaning “Inquiry, Search” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Anvesha usually hope their child will grow to embody inquiry, search and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Anvesha belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Inquiry, Search.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Anvesha total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

In Hindu literature and philosophical texts, Anvesha is widely used to express the fundamental human impulse towards growth, discovery, and understanding.

The name symbolizes the journey of the human spirit towards self-discovery, personal growth, and even ultimate union with the divine.
